annotations.title: XML format / minify / validate / to JSON

description: Validate XML (well-formedness and namespaces, with line and column for errors), pretty-print it (2, 4 spaces or tab; mixed content, CDATA and xml:space="preserve" kept exactly as written), minify it, or convert it to JSON (attributes as "@name", repeated elements as arrays, text as "#text"). Optionally removes comments. Never loads external DTDs or entities. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/xml-format/

mode.description: "format" pretty-prints, "minify" strips layout whitespace, "json" converts to JSON, "validate" only checks (never throws on bad XML).

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a XML file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

name: xml_format
